reason_code_glossary.HIGH_IMPRESSIONS: high impressions in 1-15 March compared with other pages (the model reads this as higher decline risk)
reason_code_glossary.LOW_IMPRESSIONS: low impressions in 1-15 March compared with other pages (the model reads this as higher decline risk)
reason_code_glossary.HIGH_CLICKS: high clicks in 1-15 March compared with other pages (the model reads this as higher decline risk)
reason_code_glossary.LOW_CLICKS: low clicks in 1-15 March compared with other pages (the model reads this as higher decline risk)
reason_code_glossary.HIGH_CTR: high click-through rate in 1-15 March compared with other pages (the model reads this as higher decline risk)
reason_code_glossary.LOW_CTR: low click-through rate in 1-15 March compared with other pages (the model reads this as higher decline risk)
reason_code_glossary.HIGH_POSITION: high average position number (higher = lower on the page) in 1-15 March compared with other pages (the model reads this as higher decline risk)
reason_code_glossary.LOW_POSITION: low average position number (higher = lower on the page) in 1-15 March compared with other pages (the model reads this as higher decline risk)
reason_code_glossary.HIGH_ACTIVE_DAYS: high days with impressions in 1-15 March compared with other pages (the model reads this as higher decline risk)
reason_code_glossary.LOW_ACTIVE_DAYS: low days with impressions in 1-15 March compared with other pages (the model reads this as higher decline risk)
reason_code_glossary.NO_RISK_DRIVER: no feature pushes this page's risk up

no_go: judging writers, models or client accounts
scoring other months or new metrics without re-validation
acting on FLOOR_NOISE pages from this score
client names, URLs or queries in public outputs
claim_language: observed / measured / directional / decision-support; one month; not production
